banner.text: Jamaica qualification is live all year — $45K life premium and 20 I&P. Q2 Producer Cup winners are posted below.

news.title: July District Matrix is posted
news.body: The District Performance Matrix through August folio is up in Reports, now as a sortable table you can search by name. Ranked on Personal Lines, Life, Business and Prime Score. June's edition stays available underneath it.

news.title: July Newsletter is out — June commission inside
news.body: The July district newsletter is posted below, with June commission and every leaderboard: Life, Auto, Fire, Specialty, Folio, Business and New Business Commission.

news.title: Q2 Producer Cup winners announced
news.body: McKenzie Scruggs takes first for Q2. Full top five is in the Competitions section and in the July newsletter.

news.title: Scoreboard is now live from the district sheets
news.body: Quotes and new business update straight from the D32 and D49 tracking sheets — no more waiting on a posted snapshot. Click any producer or agency for their day-by-day and week-by-week trend.

news.title: New Retail Program effective July 2026
news.body: The updated Retail Program is live: 36-month bonus structure with monthly bonuses up to 340%. Talk to the district office if you have Protégé or new-agent candidates.

events.title: Q3 ends — quarter close
events.description: Last day of the quarter. Q3 Producer Cup standings final and Topper Club pace check.

events.title: Jamaica qualifying period closes
events.description: Final day to reach $45,000 life premium and 20 I&P for the 2026 Annual Life Promo.

competitions.title: Jamaica — 2026 Annual Life Promo
competitions.description: Qualify with $45,000 life premium and 20 I&P. Agents who I&P $70,000 in life premium also bring an agency producer and their guest. Travel likely Jan/Feb 2027. FNWL reports are the official source for tracking; disputes are settled at the District Manager's discretion. No cash in lieu, no refunds or credits if the trip is not taken, and the agent must be in good standing with Farmers at the time of travel.

competitions.title: Producer Cup — Q2 winners
competitions.description: Congratulations to the Q2 Producer Cup top five. Q3 standings will be posted after the quarter closes on September 30.

competitions.title: Summer Surprise
competitions.description: Details and qualification for the Summer Surprise promo are coming from the district office. Watch this space.
